newsitem.title: USA: Brightpoint begins shipments from Nevada.
newsitem.headline: Brightpoint begins shipments from Nevada.

text.p: Brightpoint Inc said Tuesday it has begun shipping its wireless communications products from a new 65,000-square-foot distribution center in Sparks, Nev.
The company said the new facility will allow it to respond to customer restocking needs within two days throughout the United States, giving Brightpoint what it called "a true competitive advantage."
Brightpoint distributes wireless communications equipment and related products.
Its shares were up 1/8 Tuesday at 21-3/4.
